newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Seven navy staff die in Cambodian grenade attack.
newsitem.headline: Seven navy staff die in Cambodian grenade attack.

text.p: Seven Cambodian navy personnel were killed in a grenade attack after a drunken argument with a group of soldiers, officials said on Monday.

Five other navy personnel and three civilians were wounded when the soldiers fired four rocket-propelled grenades into a restaurant in the southwestern province of Koh Kong, a senior provincial official said.
The attack was sparked by an exchange of banter between the two groups eating and drinking in the restaurant on Friday night, the official said.
In a separate incident, Cambodian authorities said on Monday they had seized a container load of weapons at the main port of Sihanoukville.
Weapons and flak jackets were found in the container and the incident was being investigated, an interior ministry official said.
The political mood in Cambodia has been tense in recent months after a series of arguments between the country's co-prime ministers who head a crumbling coalition.
